messages:
Alex Chen: Quick follow-up on the adapter surface choice matrix RFC. Goal: make fallback semantics explicit so hosted/dedicated/private routes behave predictably.
Priya Nair: Saw a couple of customer traces where private fell back to a lower-capacity model even though hosted stayed healthy. Could be probe signal mismatch.
Marco Ortega: Can you paste the probe snippet? I want to see if it's timeout vs auth.
Priya Nair: ```text
[2026-03-20T12:03:12Z] probe tenant=acme seq=42 result=timeout latency_ms=4100
[2026-03-20T12:03:12Z] auth tenant=acme result=ok
```
Jun Park: Proposal: don't rely on opaque 'failure' bits. Add explicit `fallback_reason` in the manifest/handshake: one of {latency, capacity, auth, quota, circuit}. Router picks fallback model based on reason.
Lina Gomez: Also include `confidence` float so we can avoid aggressive flapping. Hysteresis required.
Alex Chen: Operationally I like a 3-state model: OK, DEGRADED (advises fallback), UNAVAILABLE (force fallback). Use a 30s window for DEGRADED->UNAVAILABLE and 2x for UNAVAILABLE->OK.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary of adapter-probe-v2 at 2026-03-22T03:00Z :calendar: 
Marco Ortega: We'll need to extend the host->adapter handshake schema to advertise which `fallback_reasons` it can emit and what confidence means.
Priya Nair: That will break old sidecars unless we translate. Suggest control plane implements a shim mapping old boolean signals -> new enums for 6 months.
Jun Park: Metrics: add `fallback_reason` tag to request/trace spans. SLO reporting can then split errors by reason.
Lina Gomez: I'll add dashboard tickets. We should include example Kibana filters and new panels for reason + tenant.
Alex Chen: Action items (owner / due):
- Jun Park: draft manifest field spec + example (due 2026-03-24)
- Marco Ortega: change probe/logging to emit `fallback_hint` (PR + test) (due 2026-03-25)
- Lina Gomez: dashboards + alerts update ticket (due 2026-03-26)
- Priya Nair: replay traces on private cluster to measure false positives (due 2026-03-27)
Notes: Keep hosted default behavior unchanged until we opt-in customers; dedicated may opt-in earlier.
Marco Ortega: I'll open branches today and ping reviewers. Small compatibility note: adapters that only send boolean `degraded=true` will map to `fallback_reason=latency, confidence=0.6` by default.
Priya Nair: Thanks. One more ask: can we include a human-readable `reason_hint` in logs for quicker triage? e.g., `reason_hint=probe_timeout_seq42`
Alex Chen: Yes — log-level string + structured tag. Keep it short.
Lina Gomez: Filing dashboard ticket now. :spiral_calendar:
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — this should reduce cross-mode surprises. :thumbsup:
